title: CollectionReceipt v1
description: Custody receipt for one central collection: it binds the EXACT required artifact set (ids + digests) the Core durably holds. It is not a completeness claim for the whole flight and NOT a deletion token (ADR-0002: COMMITTED binds one manifest revision, never the whole store). A collection with a missing or damaged required artifact gets no receipt. Digest rule: receipt_sha256 is the hex SHA256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the object excluding the digest field itself.

upload_id.description: The ingest session that carried the bytes for this collection.

artifact_set_sha256.description: Digest over the sorted (artifact_id, sha256) pairs of the REQUIRED set. One digest fixes the whole set; changing any byte changes it.

receipt_sha256.description: Digest of the canonical receipt excluding this field. The receipt is the custody proof; it is NOT a deletion token.
